why: Temples built with interlocking joints and no nails, some standing for over a thousand years.

why: Matthias Wandel builds machines out of plywood, including a wooden combination lock.

title: Reading tree rings
why: Dendrochronology dates old buildings, paintings and past climates from the pattern of rings in timber.
